title: Seat comfort and heating controls
summary: Feedback on this topic centers on generally comfortable seats, with some complaints about reduced comfort versus prior models and missing physical controls for climate and seat-heating functions.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the seats as comfortable or excellent, including comments about avoiding backache.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on seat comfort deterioration, seats feeling less comfortable than previous models, and seating that is not very comfortable.

mixed.summary: Mixed reviews mention comfort-feature drawbacks such as missing front-seat climate separation, lack of rear-seat controls, and no physical controls for AC or seat heating.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined snippets mention seat comfort or seat access but do not provide enough context to assign a clear positive, negative, or neutral view.

limitations: The sampled evidence is limited and many topic fragments are undetermined, so specific themes beyond general seat comfort and control-related comments may be incomplete.
This topic combines seat comfort with climate and seat-heating controls, which are related but not identical subjects.
